jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: high-fidelity game UI concept, The Cartographer's Table. Edit target is the FIRST image. Preserve its miniature 3D battlefield, warm parchment interface, top resource bar, art and all unrelated layout. All interface text in English. Simplify visual hierarchy and keep readable touch targets. Collapsed measured DPS MUST be a shallow single horizontal line directly below wave summary, labelled 'Peak DPS 514.7 · W8' with a disclosure chevron; remove large number block, Last wave paragraph and measurement explanation from the COLLAPSED state. Do not remove expanded DPS capability. No production code is being implemented. Maintain 4:3 iPad landscape. Reflow the folio and touch labels; never shrink a desktop UI to tiny text. During Building, remove BOTH disabled Reroll and Reserve buttons and their unavailable captions entirely. Keep five recruit slots (three revealed and two hidden), placement instruction and pinned recipe with Built / This round / Missing. Retain the construction future-draw percentages 49%,34%,17%,0%,0%,0% in one quiet row below the cards, without an empty action area. Use the same card spacing, title alignment and visual language as Choose keeper; actions appear only once choosing is legal. Replace floating pin above Druid with the existing small cyan portrait ingredient badge if applicable. A selected placement is not recipe eligibility. The pinned fixed champion must not say RANK I.The SECOND reference is historical runtime evidence ONLY FOR EXISTING MAP ICONS, not for the overall dark UI or old game art. Preserve the implemented arched portrait badges, small candidate number bubbles, gold STAR result, ingredient MINUS and wall CROSS, violet MERGE with up-arrow, cyan pinned portrait with diamond. No replacement text plaques, huge circles, floating blue pins, neon curved link webs or new pictogram system. Only display applicable badges and use thin existing leaders for associations. Keep their shapes/colors and guarded actions, do not invent a new click contract.
